title: Settlement Desk Rule: Average Monthly Offsettable Charges at a Net Energy Metering Move-Out
content:
At a Net Energy Metering move-out termination the average monthly offsettable charges are taken from the bills of the Electric Service Agreement hosting the system, according to that agreement's status and whether it has a final bill.

**Rule.** When the hosting service agreement is closed and has a final bill, the average monthly offsettable charges are the energy charges plus the Power Supply Cost Recovery charges of its regular bills dated in the 12 months before the termination, divided by the number of those regular bills, rounded to the cent. When the hosting service agreement is active and has no final bill, they are the same sums over all of its bills dated in those 12 months, divided by their number, rounded to the cent. In any other case this twelve-month averaging does not apply.

**Records read.** The status of the hosting Electric Service Agreement (active, closed, and so on), whether a final bill has been issued on it, and for each of its bills the bill date, the bill kind (regular or final), the energy charge and the Power Supply Cost Recovery charge.

## Method by status

| Hosting service agreement | Bills averaged | Divided by |
|---|---|---|
| Closed, with a final bill | Regular bills dated in the 12 months before the termination (the final bill is left out) | The number of those regular bills |
| Active, with no final bill | All bills dated in the 12 months before the termination | The number of those bills |
| Any other status or combination | Twelve-month averaging does not apply | — |

## Hypothetical worked case

Hypothetical inputs: a closed hosting service agreement with a final bill and 11 regular bills dated in the 12 months before the termination, whose energy charges total 858.66 and Power Supply Cost Recovery charges total 24.31.

- Sum of the charges: 882.97.
- Average: 882.97 divided by 11, that is 80.27.
